messages:
marta: Heads-up  we have a contractor converting to FTE and manager wants to make the promotion effective same day as conversion. Any special steps for benefits waiting periods and promo evidence?
kevin: Congrats to the candidate! Two quick flags: benefits eligibility sometimes has a 30-day waiting window on US payroll and contractor comp history may affect retro pay. Which countries are involved?
marta: Candidate is UK-based now, converting to US-based on day 0 of the new role. Manager prefers promo on conversion date to avoid duplicate titles in handoff.
aoife: Cross-border conversion + promo is doable but requires coordinated sign-off: People Ops + Payroll + Comp Ops. Benefits enrollment: if conversion places them on US payroll mid-cycle we may have limited windows for health plan start dates.
kevin: For evidence: conversion packets often assume role change is documented in hire paperwork. But promo evidence still needs manager-provided impact examples. If the manager bundles conversion+higher band, note the changed scope in the hire packet and attach promo evidence.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: leveling checklist at https://intra.redwood/people-ops/leveling-checklist. Required: 2+ concrete examples, measurable outcomes, manager endorsement, peer feedback where available. Use /templates/leveling-evidence.md.
comp-ops: If you want base increase effective at conversion + grant alignment, Comp Ops must approve grant timing and quantify retro. For cross-border conversions we usually calculate retro in the country that paid the earlier period; expect manual adjustments.
marta: What about peer feedback? Manager says most peers are external contractors who interacted earlier this year. Is that acceptable?
aoife: External contractor feedback can be supplementary but we prefer internal peer feedback <6 months. If only contractor feedback exists, add manager attestation and extra metrics to corroborate impact.
kevin: Handback language we use: "Thanks  please add 2 quantified examples, attach any internal peer feedback <6 months or manager attestation, and confirm proposed effective date with payroll. Resubmit within 14 days." Feel free to paste.
aoife: Approval flow for exceptions: Manager -> People Ops Sr Partner -> Comp Ops. Executive verbal ok as context but not sufficient. Record any exec direction in the Promo Portal comments.
marta: Great. Any tips to avoid benefits gaps?
comp-ops: Best practice: align conversion promo date to first day of a pay period where possible and confirm benefits start date with People Ops benefits team before publishing offer. If unavoidable, prepare a one-time benefits enrollment exception and document in HRIS.
kevin: I'll ping payroll and benefits for the exact cutoffs and post them here. If we can't get alignment, consider a short backdated comp correction rather than changing the conversion start date.
marta: Thanks all  will resubmit with the manager and use the handback copy.
